name: What Happens Now

voice.note: placeholder: same Mark voice as Jin until Justin picks one per channel

image_style: Simple hand-drawn stick figure cartoon, like the attached sample (stickman-style.png). Black ink lines, one even line weight. Round head with a simple face (dot eyes, a big readable expression), single-line arms and legs; a plain shirt or tie shape only when the story needs it. Props are simple black outline doodles. Colour: only the one main thing this picture is about (the scene names it as the coloured thing) is filled with flat, bright, natural colour inside its black outline, like a colouring book page; every other person, object and the whole place stay black ink lines only, with no colour at all. Plain flat pure white background with no texture; every scene's place is drawn with simple outline lines. No shading, no gradients, no realistic detail, no words or letters (simple symbols like $ are fine), no watermark, no frame. Vertical 9:16, subject centred with room above and below for captions.
